title: Expose planning create CLI
description: Register wtp planning create with the complete task metadata flag surface, including --status, six grouping flags, repeatable dependency/reusable inputs as established by the completed contracts, priority, estimate, lane, model, origin, and assignee. Default status to toplan; distinguish omitted values from explicit empties exactly as task create does; reject blank required/grouping values and execution statuses. Preserve Git/worktree origin discovery parity. Return the typed planning item with stable root --json output and a concise human identifier/title/status line. Add parser-order, legacy-global-flag isolation, Unicode, defaults, explicit overrides, invalid combinations, and output tests.
